title: 第4154章 探险家助 翻译搭建沟通桥第4150章 新航提议 代表c的宇宙新程
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
光莲静静浮在方浩胸前一尺处，辉光映着他脸上细微的纹路，一闪，又一闪。他没动，也没说话，袖口那根猫毛早被气流卷走了，掌心空着，指尖微微发僵。
平台两侧的弟子们连呼吸都压低了半度。有个负责记录的文书刚捡起笔，又忘了写什么，只好盯着地面发愣。远处主控室的数据流还在滚，可谁也没心思去看。
方浩终于眨了下眼。
风没动，旗没动，但他觉得，这客，大概是能见的——只要别让他先开口。
偏偏没人接话。
就在这时候，通道尽头传来一阵脚步声，不紧不慢，鞋底带着点沙砾摩擦金属板的响动。来人穿着件旧得发白的星巡袍，肩上挂着个布满划痕的记录仪，腰间别着三支不同型号的翻译笔，走一步晃一下，像随时会散架。
“让让，让让。”那人边说边从人群里挤进来，顺手从怀里掏出一块啃了一半的干饼，咬了一口，含糊道：“沟通这事，得讲方法论。”
方浩侧头一看，认出来了：“你不是那个总在灵网论坛刷‘我见过七种外星打招呼方式’的BB？”
“正是。”BB咽下饼，抹了把嘴，“而且我刚签到完，系统出品，绝不坑爹。”
方浩眼皮一跳：“那是我的口头禅。”
“现在是咱俩共用的。”BB已经站到了平台中央，正对着DD，抬头打量那层流动光晕，眯起眼，“古伽马语系，意念编码，靠情绪共振传信息——老掉牙了，但挺有情怀。”
DD没动，光莲依旧悬浮。
BB也不急，闭上眼，深吸一口气，像是在闻空气里的味道。然后他抬起右手，掌心朝上，缓缓释放出一段记忆画面：一片星海，一艘破船，他自己坐在船头啃另一块干饼，背景音乐是某首跑调的民谣。
能量光丝从他指尖溢出，虽不如DD的流畅，但也勉强成形，在空中晃了两下，朝对方飘去。
DD的光晕微颤了一下。
紧接着，他抬手回应，同样一段光丝射出，画面变了：还是那片星海，但船修好了，民谣也调准了，连干饼都被换成了热腾腾的肉夹馍。
BB睁眼，咧嘴一笑：“通了。”
他转头对方浩说：“他说你站这么久没动，算是通过了第一关测试，叫‘静立三息不退者，可授信任之芽’。那朵花，是他文明里最轻的礼节，比请人喝茶还普通。”
方浩：“……所以我要是躲了，是不是就得重考？”
“差不多。”BB点头，“可能还得交补考费。”

方浩没再问，只盯着那光莲看了两秒，忽然伸手，不是去碰，而是做了个抓锅盖的动作——掌心向下，猛地一扣。
光莲轻轻一震，化作点点辉光，顺着他的手腕流入胸口，像热水浇进铜壶，暖了一下，没了。
全场安静。
几息后，有位执事长老忍不住低声嘀咕：“这算收下了？没反噬？没炸经脉？”
“要炸早炸了。”BB回头瞥了他一眼，“你当人家千里迢迢跑来给你送渡劫雷劫模拟器？”
长老闭嘴。
方浩这时才往前迈了一步，拱手道：“既然是礼，我们收得坦然。但光图、光花、光人，咱们看是看懂了，话还得靠人说。请问尊使远来，所为何事？”
BB立刻转向DD，神情专注，像是在等一道数学题的答案。
content_en:
The light lotus floated quietly a foot away from Fang Hao's chest, and its light reflected the subtle lines on his face, flashing one after another. He didn't move or speak. The cat hair on his sleeves had long been swept away by the airflow. His palms were empty and his fingertips were slightly stiff.
The disciples on both sides of the platform even lowered their breathing by half a degree. A clerk in charge of recording just picked up the pen and forgot what to write, so he could only stare at the ground in a daze. The data stream in the main control room in the distance is still rolling, but no one is interested in watching it.
Fang Hao finally blinked.
The wind didn't move, the flag didn't move, but he felt that this guest could probably be seen - as long as he didn't let him speak first.
But no one answered.
At this moment, there was a sound of footsteps coming from the end of the passage, slow and steady, and the sound of the soles of the shoes rubbing against the metal plate with a little bit of gravel. The person who came was wearing an old and white star patrol robe, with a scratched recorder hanging on his shoulder, and three different types of translation pens on his waist. If he took a step, it would fall apart at any time.
"Give me, give me." The man said as he squeezed in from the crowd, took out a half-eaten piece of dry biscuit from his arms, took a bite, and said vaguely: "For communication, you need to talk about methodology."
Fang Hao looked sideways and recognized: "Aren't you that BB who always writes 'I've seen seven ways of greeting aliens' on the Spirit Network forum?"
"Exactly." BB swallowed the cake and wiped his mouth, "And I just finished signing in. It is produced by the system, and I will never cheat."
Fang Hao's eyelids twitched: "That's my mantra."
"We share it now." BB has stood in the center of the platform, facing DD, looking up at the flowing halo, squinting his eyes, "Ancient Gamma language system, encoding of thoughts, relying on emotional resonance to transmit information - cliché, but quite sentimental."
DD didn't move, Guanglian was still suspended.
BB was not in a hurry. He closed his eyes and took a deep breath, as if he was smelling the air. Then he raised his right hand, palm facing up, and slowly released a memory scene: a sea of ​​stars, a broken ship, himself sitting on the bow of the ship eating another piece of dry biscuit, and the background music was a certain off-key ballad.
Energy rays overflowed from his fingertips. Although not as smooth as DD's, they still managed to take shape. They swayed twice in the air and floated towards the opponent.
DD's halo trembled slightly.
Then, he raised his hand to respond, and the same piece of light shot out, and the scene changed: it was still the same sea of ​​stars, but the ship was repaired, the folk songs were tuned correctly, and even the dry biscuits were replaced by hot meat buns.
BB opened his eyes and grinned: "Okay."
He turned to Fang Hao and said, "He said that you have passed the first test by standing still for so long, which is called 'Those who stand still for three breaths without retreating can be given the buds of trust.' That flower is the lightest courtesy in his civilization, and it is more common than inviting someone to drink tea."
Fang Hao: "...So if I hide, will I have to retake the exam?"
"Absolutely." BB nodded, "You may have to pay a make-up exam fee."
Fang Hao didn't ask any more questions, just stared at the light lotus for two seconds, and suddenly stretched out his hand, not to touch it, but to grab the lid of the pot - with his palm downwards, he slammed it.
The light lotus shook slightly and turned into little glows, flowing down his wrist into his chest, like hot water poured into a copper pot, it warmed for a while and then disappeared.
The whole place was quiet.
After a few breaths, one of the deacons and elders couldn't help but murmured in a low voice: "Is this considered accepted? No backlash? No meridians exploded?"
"It would have exploded long ago." BB turned around and glanced at him, "Do you think someone came all the way to deliver you a thunder tribulation simulator?"
Elder, shut up.
Only then did Fang Hao take a step forward, cupped his hands and said: "Since it is a gift, we can accept it calmly. But we can understand the light pictures, light flowers, and light people, but we have to rely on others to speak. May I ask why your envoy came from so far away?"
BB immediately turned to DD with a focused expression, as if he was waiting for the answer to a math problem.
